clock_contract.generic_moonshot: Queue residence at the decision instant, not token birth. Original declared first_seen_epoch_s/first_seen_at dominates stale measured queue age. No generic maximum token-birth age is added.
clock_contract.special_probe: Token birth age at the decision instant with its own existing thresholds; not queue freshness. Its separate confirmed admission policy is preserved.
clock_contract.shadow_elapsed: Elapsed original observation, otherwise valid minutes_since_first_seen/shadow_age_min/age_since_seen_min. A queue-only measurement is not a shadow observation.
clock_contract.age_at_seen: Original declared creation to original declared first-seen when both exist; otherwise a strict measured age_at_seen or valid current token-age upper bound. These fields do not authenticate provider clock ownership.
clock_contract.historical_view: A detached temporal view, never a rewrite of original rows. Recorded decision_at/ts_utc/timestamp controls the view. Missing event clock does not silently recompute timestamp-derived ages today.
clock_contract.outcome_limit: Temporal consistency does not establish original availability of outcome/confirmation fields, a historical policy revision, executable liquidity, actual fills or prospective profitability. Current-config historical eligibility remains diagnostic.
